title: Moses & Mount Sinai

videos.title: EASY! MEMORIZE the 10 commandments in 3 minutes!

textBlocks:
Since escaping EGYPT about 3 months ago, the Israelites are camping at the foot of Mount Sinai

Moses climbs up the mountain several times!

#1
Exodus 19:2-7 
On the MT God tells Moses about the covenant (v5-6)
#2
Exodus 19:8
Moses returns up the MT to give God the Israelites response

#3
Exodus 19:10
God speaks to Moses again
Mt Sinai covered with smoke, trembles, trumpets
#4
Exodus 19:20-25
God tells Moses not to let the people near the mountain
#5
Exodus 20:21
God gives various laws and the Promised land
#6
Exodus 24:1
Moses, Aaron, Aaron’s sons, 70 elders.
Then Moses & Joshua stay and the rest leave
40 days v18
Moses gets the tablets
tabernacle, ark of the covenant, garments v31
descends to golden calf! 
MOSES BREAKS THE TABLETS

#7
Exodus 32:32
Begs the Lord to show mercy

# 8
Exodus 34:1
Moses to bring 2 stones
40 days
God writes the 10 commandments again
